description: Diagnostic CPU reruns. ps cumulative process CPU TIME deltas over middle80% of samples with all four validators alive; CPU seconds include all process threads and exclude I/O sleep. One core equivalent=oneCPU-second per elapsed second. Recovery excluded from CPU window; walltime window may include drain. 100ms ps sampling adds overhead. All processes share an8-logical-CPU host; per-core affinity/utilization and blocked-time traces were not captured.

report.measurement_definition: Signed transaction submission before transport enqueue to client receipt and strict Ed25519 verification of effects QC; client generation/signing excluded; network queues, fixed per-direction delay, validator validation/signing and group sync_all before votes included.
report.limits: One host, loopback TCP, fixed one-way delay without packet-loss/bandwidth modelling; one hot collective pool; bounded journal group commit; filesystem/device sync_all guarantees assumed. Finalized latency percentiles are conditional; all-submitted quantiles include right-censored stalls.

offered_load_window_cpu.description: Approximately seconds1to4 after launch, inside five-second offered window; avoids drain. TIME rounded to centiseconds.
